name: dsh-env-probe
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: probes the local machine environment (OS / shells / runtimes / tools / disks / proxy) once, caches the report, and hands the same facts to the model as tools and as /env-refresh context. v1.4.1: tool-only by default (injectSection false, notifyModel inject, cache under ~/.dsh/cache/dsh-env-probe).
